text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The first crown in full cherry blossom glory!
The crowned champion is Gentildonna!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ooooohh...!!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Commotion, is it?
How offensive.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "This victory was only to be expected, though."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Everyone!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Next, let's go greet everyone
at Tokyo's Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Next, I shall embody the strength of the Oak.
Please look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna returned gracefully,
showing no signs of fatigue from the fierce battle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"...Are those really all the words of praise
you have for the victor?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: How pedestrian.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I'll let you off with a passing grade for today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
From here on, no matter how many words of praise are sung for me,
they will never be enough.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You had better polish up your vocabulary.
Ho-ho-ho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even for someone like Gentildonna, the exhilaration
of racing can't be hidden...
No, perhaps it's more accurate to say she doesn't hide it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, that makes our
current position clear.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I am strong, just as I thought.
I stand head and shoulders above my generation."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Not out of arrogance, but as absolute truth.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks as well,
I shall unleash this power to its fullest for you."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I lost...
...Ngh!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
My eligibility for the Triple Tiara...
is gone now...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure...
I ended up disappointing you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Still...—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
A Double Crown...
can still be won...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sure that person isn't looking at me.
Even so...!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At the Oaks,
it won't go that way."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
You'll have no choice but to watch me.
To watch my back.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No matter how great their strength,
before a perfectly matched aptitude... they fall to their knees.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next race: the Oaks—
Tokyo Racecourse, 2400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Gentildonna, who has mainly run mile races up to this point,
this distance and course are still unfamiliar territory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering Gentildonna's run today,
it would be best to completely revise our training menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Well,
I wouldn't mind giving it a try for you.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It looks like the results will only make me feel
like I wasted my time, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...In other words, you wish to say no new countermeasures are needed.
However, overconfidence is not part of my job—"
choice_data_list: No, the outcome will have you thanking me.
No, you'll end up thanking me for this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I wonder if you'll still sound so confident once you know everything about me.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Giving off a sense of unfathomable potential,
we continue our training toward the second crown, the Oaks.
